items.title: Migrate MuleSoft APIs to AWS serverless with AWS Transform custom
items.summary: When you migrate a portfolio of MuleSoft applications to AWS serverless, each application brings its own decisions: how every connector maps to an AWS service, how DataWeave scripts translate to AWS equivalents, and how error-handling strategies carry over. Multiply those decisions across a portfolio, and each migration becomes a one-off exercise. In this post, explore […]
